versions.changelog:
🧠 Knowledge Internalizer Pro
Systematic Knowledge Internalization & Capability Self-Assessment Engine
Not just learning—it tells you exactly "how much you know" and "what you can do."

Core Features
🔍 Exploratory Learning

Multi-dimensional search across 5 angles: definition, principles, comparison,前沿, applications
Prioritized sources: academic papers → official docs →权威 surveys → tutorials
📦 Deep Structuring

Concept-Relation Knowledge Graph
5-layer Hierarchical Knowledge Framework
Pre-generated Q&A pairs
📊 Self Capability Rating ⭐ (Key Feature)

4 dimensions: Breadth, Depth, Credibility, Structuring
4-tier system: Concept → Understanding → Proficiency → Expert
Clear boundaries: what you can/cannot do
💾 Persistent Storage

Auto-archive to knowledge base
Auto-load on future queries
Triggers
"Deep study {subject} and assess your mastery level"
"Build an expert-level knowledge base on {topic}"
"Systematically learn {domain} and tell me what you can do"
Why It Matters
✅ Systematic learning process (not scattered info gathering)
✅ Structured knowledge storage (reusable)
✅ Rigorous capability rating (know your limits)

Perfect for: Exploring new domains, building expertise, understanding your capability boundaries.

Knowledge Internalizer Pro 1.0.0

- 全新发布：构建系统化知识内化与能力自评引擎。
- 支持针对新领域的结构化学习与专家级知识库生成。
- 集成多阶段闭环学习流程（探索、结构化、评级、存储）。
- 自动生成知识图谱、树状知识框架和动态问答对。
- 提供多维度能力自评报告，明确能力等级与边界。
- 持久化存储知识资产，便于后续调用与快速检索。
